segments.title: 第111章 她的頭發
segments.content:
"You need to learn how to vocalize correctly. The high notes are still a bit strained."

"Follow me, make a 'na' sound, and then go up the scale."

"Right, feel the power from your chest. Don't switch completely to falsetto. The high notes in this song will sound powerless in falsetto."

Although he had used a little trick to get Yan Zhusheng to stay behind for individual training.

When it came to matters related to music, Yan Zhusheng was exceptionally serious.

If there ever was such a music teacher, then Teacher Yan would definitely be an outstanding and competent one.

This was something Li Luo had experienced firsthand in his past life.

Now, receiving Yan Zhusheng's earnest guidance was merely a reenactment of their past interactions.

This sent Li Luo into a bit of a trance, as if he had not been reborn, and Yan Zhusheng was still that musical girl whose heart condition had not yet been discovered.

The two of them spent their time in the house: one singing while the other filmed, one reading while the other edited, one playing the piano while the other uploaded videos.

With the monthly income of over ten thousand yuan provided by Yan Zhusheng, the work was extremely relaxed and pleasant, and he had such a beautiful young boss to delight his eyes.

That period of time was truly unforgettable for Li Luo.

Unfortunately, it lasted for only half a year. Yan Zhusheng flew abroad, and Li Luo once again became unemployed.

Who could have imagined that after everything started over, he would meet her again in a new high school?

"You're spacing out," Yan Zhusheng said. "Am I not teaching well?"

"No." Li Luo shook his head. "I just had a moment of epiphany."

"What did you realize?"

"Guess?"

Yan Zhusheng looked at him but didn't actually guess. She just reached out to put the guitar away and then said, "If you're tired, let's call it a day."

"But there are still more than ten minutes before class ends." Li Luo glanced at the time. "Should we go back to the classroom?"

"How about we take a walk before heading back?" Yan Zhusheng tilted her head in thought, then suggested, "I want to go for a run."

"That's fine." Li Luo nodded and followed Yan Zhusheng out of the activity room.

As they walked toward the sports field, Li Luo couldn't help but ask, "Have you been running to exercise recently?"

"I wake up a bit earlier in the morning and go for a run on the field," Yan Zhusheng said. "At night, I go straight back to the dorm."

Speaking of which, Yan Zhusheng suddenly thought of something and turned to look at Li Luo. "Do you want to run with me?"

"Huh?"

"Wake up a little earlier in the morning and come to school for a morning run together."

"Doesn't the school have morning exercises during the long break after ten?" The moment Li Luo heard about waking up early, he shook his head repeatedly. "You might as well kill me than make me wake up early."

"Then..." Yan Zhusheng thought for a moment. "We could go for a run on the field together after the second evening self-study session ends? The sports meet is coming up soon, so we can train in advance."

"That's not impossible." Li Luo was now in the body of a 15-year-old, so he wasn't averse to running and exercising. "But I have to let Xixi and Senior know."

As they were talking, they arrived at the sports field.

Yan Zhusheng took out the Bluetooth earbuds Ying Chanxi had given her from her pocket, put one in her ear, handed the other to Li Luo, and then turned on music on her phone.

Rhythmic, workout-style music started playing in their ears.

As Yan Zhusheng began to run, Li Luo quickly followed suit.

Sharing the music from the earbuds, the two of them started jogging slowly around the track.

Not far away, the school building was brightly lit.

But the sports field was dim, making it hard to see clearly.

Neither of them spoke while running. They only gradually slowed to a stop when the bell for the end of the third evening self-study session rang.

Li Luo handed the earbud back to her, and they walked towards the classroom building together.

Along the way, many classmates from Class 8 saw the two of them going upstairs, and most were somewhat surprised.

After all, both of them had been gone for the entire evening self-study session. Li Luo was a day student, yet he hadn't gone home at this hour.

And looking at their current state...

"Yan Zhusheng's face is so red."

"Why hasn't the class president gone home? What was he doing? Why is he panting?"

"What the hell! What were they doing all evening!"

"Tsk, tsk. My junior high classmates from other classes were even asking me about Yan Zhusheng. Now I can just tell them to give up."

"No way, maybe it was something else?"

"I think it was training for the rock club? Didn't someone say they were both in it?"

"Who knows, anyway, I saw there was something fishy between them a long time ago."

"The class president is so lucky with the ladies, damn it! The prettiest girl in class was snatched up so quickly."

After passing by the two, many rumors began to spread among the students of Class 8.

Back in the classroom, Li Luo picked up his schoolbag and walked out of the school with Yan Zhusheng.

After watching her walk towards the dormitory complex across the street, Li Luo parted ways with Yan Zhusheng at the school gate and then returned to 1502, Bihai Lanting.

As soon as he entered, he saw Xu Youyu sitting cross-legged on the sofa, with the wooden stick of a finished mini-popsicle dangling from her mouth.

Seeing Li Luo enter, Xu Youyu glanced at him and huffed, "You still know how to come back? I was even waiting for a late-night snack."

"Where's Xixi?"

"She went back to her room after her shower."

"What about you?" Li Luo glanced at Xu Youyu. "Don't tell me you were really waiting for me to come back and make a late-night snack?"

By now, Xu Youyu had also showered and changed into her pajamas, a loose-fitting white nightdress that concealed the curves of her figure.

"You're overthinking it." Xu Youyu stretched on the sofa. "I got busy again after coming back. I'm going to sleep after finishing this mini-popsicle."

With that, she sat up, put on her slippers, and started walking toward her bedroom.

But as she passed by Li Luo, Xu Youyu suddenly stopped and looked at his face carefully with a puzzled expression. "Why does it look like you've been sweating a bit?"

"I went for a run tonight."

"Didn't you say you were going to the rock club for training?" Xu Youyu had a suspicious look on her face. "They have physical training too?"

"Well, the sports meet is coming up soon." Li Luo blurted out a lie. "As the class president, I must lead by example, participate actively, and win honor for our class."

"Hah." Xu Youyu kicked him lightly. "Who are you being sarcastic with? As if I'm not a class president myself."

"...Some people just insist on taking it personally, what can I do?" Li Luo rolled his eyes. "By the way, Senior, are there any sports meet events you're good at?"

Xu Youyu crossed her arms over her chest, as if showing off her burdens. "Do I look like a combatant to you? The student council president has a lot of work to do, okay."

"That must be really tough for you." Li Luo subconsciously glanced down, and in the next second, his eyes met Xu Youyu's. He couldn't help but click his tongue.

I got caught again!

"You've improved this time," Xu Youyu said, waving with a grin as she walked back to her bedroom, teasing him. "It only took you two seconds of staring to notice that I'd noticed you. Keep up the good work."

The bedroom door closed.

Li Luo let out a couple of dry laughs and headed toward his own bedroom.

But halfway there, Ying Chanxi's door opened with a click.

Carrying a bedsheet, Ying Chanxi walked out, took the sheet, and stuffed it into the washing machine in the bathroom. Then she looked at Li Luo in the hallway. "You're back."

"Why do I get the feeling you're in a bad mood?"

Hearing Li Luo say this, Ying Chanxi glanced up at him but didn't respond to his question. She just walked silently toward Li Luo's room. "Let me help you change your bedsheet too, we can wash them together."

"Oh, I'll help you." Li Luo followed her into his bedroom and watched as Ying Chanxi, with extreme familiarity, opened his closet and, knowing it better than he did, took out a clean bedsheet and placed it on the bedside table, ready to be used.

Then Ying Chanxi walked to the side of the bed, bent over, and pinched a corner of the bedsheet, about to lift it off.

But in the next second, her gaze suddenly sharpened, her brows furrowed slightly, and her right hand reached onto the bed, lightly picking up a single strand of hair.

"Li Luo, what is this?"

(End of Chapter)
